unpacking.attachment: nearest main bounding-box distance; actual boundary pixel distance breaks ties; far threshold0.3cellmax; ambiguous/far attachments reported
unpacking.pivot: source cell-center X; common max primary bottom across source row Y; no per-frame normalization
unpacking.scale: one constant scale per source path, fitting maximum anchored group extents into content box
unpacking.sampling: sourceX=floor(pivotX+(x+0.5-anchorX)/scale); sourceY=floor(pivotY+(y-translationY+0.5-anchorY)/scale); use this pivot form to reproduce floating-point sampling
